vorlage_datei.label: Angebotsvorlage (PDF/Dokument)
vorlage_datei.description:
An uploaded file (or `null`/`None`).

The field value will be the URL to download the file in the form `https://my.living-apps.de/files/6aa27329e0c6d41166a81758/data/<record-id>/<control-identifier>/<internal-id>` (or `null`/`None`).

projekt.label: Zugewiesenes Projekt
projekt.description:
A reference to a LivingApp record from the target lookup app 'Projekte' with the id `6aa273295a15f8de72caafa5` (or `null`/`None`).

The field value will be a valid record URL in the form `https://my.living-apps.de/rest/apps/6aa273295a15f8de72caafa5/records/<record-id>` (or `null`/`None`).

When writing, either pass a record URL through exactly as this API returned it, or send the portable relative form `/apps/6aa273295a15f8de72caafa5/records/<record-id>`. Other equivalent record-URL forms are accepted as well.

Displayed as single-select field in HTML pages.

angebotsstatus.label: Angebotsstatus
angebotsstatus.description:
One selected option of multiple available options (or `null`/`None`).

The available options are defined in the `lookup_data` attribute of this control.

The field value will be the key in this `lookup_data` attribute (or `null`/`None`).

Displayed as single-select field in HTML pages.
